gloss: to be conceited; to think too much of oneself

definitions.gloss: to be conceited; to be full of oneself; to think too highly of oneself
definitions.explanation: To believe one is cleverer, more attractive, or more capable than one really is. Always critical, whether said of someone else or, in self-mockery, of oneself. Often written in kana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{褒|ほ}められて→褒める：01204_homeru⟧{自惚|うぬぼ}れる。
examples.english: To get conceited after a little praise.

examples.japanese: {自惚|うぬぼ}れる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい{加減|かげん}→いい加減：09353_iikagen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Stop being so full of yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{自惚|うぬぼ}れて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完敗|かんぱい}→完敗：15654_kanpai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was conceited enough to think he was the best, but he was soundly beaten in the match.

notes:
The noun is {自惚|うぬぼ}れ (conceit). The thing one is vain about is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or stated in a ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ clause: ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自惚|うぬぼ}れる, ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{自惚|うぬぼ}れる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自惚|うぬぼ}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be conceited (state)
- {自惚|うぬぼ}れるな: don't get a big head
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自惚|うぬぼ}れる: to be vain about one's talent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}い{上|あ}がる: to be arrogant — stresses looking down on others
- ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かける: to boast of, to be stuck-up about (a specific advantage)
